source.check: divisions, names, votes, registers, spoiled papers and percentage polls read from the Irish News's Newry (No. 1) Rural District Council returns (6 June 1936, p. 9)

note: Triennial rural district council election, Newry No. 1 (County Down), fourteen divisions. Polling took place on Thursday 4 June 1936 in the three contested divisions (Carrickcrossan, Rathfriland North, Rathfriland South); four divisions had a single nomination and in seven no nomination was made, the sitting member continuing (Newry Reporter, 7 May 1936, p. 5). Peters, the outgoing member, beat Murray by nine votes. The Irish News printed Murray as a Unionist and the News-Letter as a Nationalist, so the label is left as the vote only. 250 (66.8 per cent) voted, with three spoiled papers.
